plain_english_policy: Advocate for increased state funding for public K-12 schools, prioritizing teacher salaries and classroom resources. Propose a property tax cap exemption for school districts to reduce local budget strain. Fund via targeted sales tax increases on non-essential goods (e.g., tobacco, alcohol) and redirecting unused federal education grants.
evidence_quote: My top priorities would be **1)** securing $50 million annually in state funding for teacher stipends and **2)** allocating $30 million to modernize aging school infrastructure. To fund this, I support a temporary 2% sales tax hike on luxury items while ensuring no new property taxes burden homeowners.
review_reason: Explicitly ties funding increases to state resources and regressive tax shifts (sales tax), aligning with conservative fiscal priorities.
